name: Paygent Connect
description: Finance and Fintech: Japanese payment service provider (Mitsubishi UFJ Nicos / DeNA JV) whose 'connect' integration module enables server-to-server credit card, konbini and bank-transfer payments for merchants.
access_notes: No self-serve developer signup. Merchants apply via the merchant administrator site, return a stamped paper application with corporate documents, and each payment method is screened by the underlying payment institutions before test and then production environments are granted. API specs and the test-environment connection kit are only downloadable after contract from the login-gated merchant portal. Authentication is a proprietary scheme: mutual-TLS client certificates plus a connection ID/password (and registered source IP addresses).
mcp_notes: No vendor MCP server found on paygent.co.jp and no Paygent toolkit found in the Composio toolkits index (docs.composio.dev/toolkits).
uncertainty_notes: The assignment hint said 'paygent (NMI-powered)' but searches ('"Paygent Connect" NMI payment gateway', '"paygent" transactiongateway.com NMI white label') found no evidence linking Paygent to NMI; NMI is a separate US white-label gateway. 'paygent/connect' is Paygent's own Composer package name for its PHP B2B module (PaygentB2BModule), which wraps a proprietary HTTPS POST 'telegram' interface — 'rest' here means plain HTTPS server-to-server calls, not a documented RESTful API. Full API breadth and webhook/notification support could not be determined because specifications sit behind the contract-gated merchant portal (this is login-gating, not proof of absence).

evidence.note: Official onboarding flow: apply via merchant admin site, mail stamped application with official documents, screening by each payment institution, then test and production environment setup.
Official setup manual: client certificate (.pfx) install required to access even the test environment; connection credentials issued via the merchant administrator site.

Third-party integration walkthrough of the paygent/connect PHP module (PaygentB2BModule): client cert path, CA bundle, connection ID/password config — confirms module + proprietary server-to-server interface (lead, not vendor proof).
Official merchant support FAQ: manuals/specifications are downloaded from the login-gated merchant administrator site ('マニュアル/仕様書'), i.e. docs are contract-gated.
